{{Top|leg}}
The '''Planetary Communications Commission''' was an organization based in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Wullerton]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Draenell's Point]]. An undercover [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] agent worked in the Commission during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].
